import importlib
import os
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np


def _trapezoid(y, x):
    if hasattr(np, "trapezoid"):
        return float(np.trapezoid(y, x))
    return float(np.trapz(y, x))


def _load_pybamm(source_root: Path):
    os.environ.setdefault("PYBAMM_DISABLE_TELEMETRY", "1")
    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", message="pkg_resources is deprecated as an API.*")
    source_text = str(source_root)
    if source_text not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, source_text)
    return importlib.import_module("pybamm")


def _model_parts(pybamm, direction: str, boundary_value: float):
    x = pybamm.SpatialVariable("x", domain="domain", coord_sys="cartesian")
    u = pybamm.Variable("u", domain="domain")
    if direction == "upwind":
        side = "left"
        edge_state = pybamm.upwind(u)
        velocity = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcastToEdges(1.0, ["domain"])
    elif direction == "downwind":
        side = "right"
        edge_state = pybamm.downwind(u)
        velocity = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcastToEdges(-1.0, ["domain"])
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown direction {direction!r}")
    bcs = {u: {side: (pybamm.Scalar(boundary_value), "Dirichlet")}}
    return x, u, edge_state, velocity, bcs


def _mesh_and_disc(pybamm, x, npts: int):
    geometry = {"domain": {x: {"min": pybamm.Scalar(0), "max": pybamm.Scalar(1)}}}
    mesh = pybamm.Mesh(geometry, {"domain": pybamm.Uniform1DSubMesh}, {x: npts})
    disc = pybamm.Discretisation(mesh, {"domain": pybamm.FiniteVolume()})
    return mesh, disc


def edge_observation(pybamm, case: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = np.asarray(case["profile"], dtype=float)
    direction = str(case["direction"])
    boundary_value = float(case["boundary_value"])
    x, u, edge_state, _velocity, bcs = _model_parts(pybamm, direction, boundary_value)

    model = pybamm.BaseModel()
    model.rhs = {u: -u}
    model.initial_conditions = {u: pybamm.Scalar(0)}
    model.boundary_conditions = bcs
    model.variables = {"edge_state": edge_state}

    _mesh, disc = _mesh_and_disc(pybamm, x, int(profile.size))
    processed = disc.process_model(model, inplace=False)
    edges = np.asarray(processed.variables["edge_state"].evaluate(y=profile[:, None])).reshape(-1)
    finite = bool(edges.size == profile.size + 1 and np.all(np.isfinite(edges)))
    interior = edges[1:-1] if edges.size > 2 else edges
    return {
        "name": case["name"],
        "direction": direction,
        "boundary_value": boundary_value,
        "cell_count": int(profile.size),
        "finite": finite,
        "edge_count": int(edges.size),
        "edge_min": float(np.min(edges)) if edges.size else None,
        "edge_max": float(np.max(edges)) if edges.size else None,
        "edge_span": float(np.max(edges) - np.min(edges)) if edges.size else None,
        "interior_edge_mean": float(np.mean(interior)) if interior.size else None,
    }


def transient_observation(pybamm, case: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    direction = str(case["direction"])
    boundary_value = float(case["boundary_value"])
    source = float(case["source"])
    npts = int(case["mesh_points"])
    t_final = float(case["t_final"])
    time_points = int(case["time_points"])
    x, u, edge_state, velocity, bcs = _model_parts(pybamm, direction, boundary_value)

    model = pybamm.BaseModel()
    model.rhs = {u: -pybamm.div(edge_state * velocity) + source}
    model.initial_conditions = {u: pybamm.Scalar(0)}
    model.boundary_conditions = bcs
    model.variables = {"u": u, "x": x}

    _mesh, disc = _mesh_and_disc(pybamm, x, npts)
    processed = disc.process_model(model, inplace=False)

    finite = bool(final.size == npts and np.all(np.isfinite(final)))

        "name": case["name"],
        "direction": direction,
        "mesh_points": npts,
        "boundary_value": boundary_value,
        "source": source,
        "t_final": t_final,
        "finite": finite,
        "solution_min": float(np.min(final)) if final.size else None,

        "solution_span": float(np.max(final) - np.min(final)) if final.size else None,

        "mass_like_integral": _trapezoid(final, x_values) if final.size else None,
        "left_value": float(final[0]) if final.size else None,
        "right_value": float(final[-1]) if final.size else None,

    pybamm = _load_pybamm(task_root / "source")

    ]

        "finite": bool(finite),
        "edge_observations": edge_results,
        "transient_observations": transient_results,
